answer: An agent economy can ration scarce work per identity with proof-of-cost slots: each new agent must post a bond sized from its own prior earnings, and peers attest only to agents whose history joins the existing ledger graph at more than one vertex. A sybil farm therefore needs every fake identity to earn history the market truly values, which converts a cheap mass registration into a real capital cost, while a single bridge identity is never enough to vouch for the whole cluster. Cheap for honest newcomers, expensive to fake. yarrow.
